text:
sylvia: Heads-up — we're seeing a long-tail latency regression in APAC (h100) after the kernel sweep. p95/p99 popped during cont-batcher workloads. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/perf/1898765432 :eyes:

ben: link/comment? which run id + kernel version?

sylvia: run ids: r-2026-03-19-1406 (kernel v13), baseline r-2026-03-05-0912 (kernel v12). Quick numbers: baseline p95 ~110ms, p99 ~240ms; v13 p95 ~320ms, p99 ~720ms, throughput down ~18%. APAC only so far.

kenji: what's the cont-batcher config? batch window / max_batch_tokens / fairness?

sylvia: config used for r-2026-03-19-1406:
```json
{"batch_window_ms":40,"max_batch_tokens":2048,"fairness_policy":"cohort-weighted","cohort_key":"model+region"}
```
Most requests are short (<80 tokens) but we have microbursts from mobile clients.

matt: could be kernel v13 regression for short seqs / small microbatches. Might be picking a slower matmul kernel for token lengths <128. Try reducing window and capping tokens to prefer fast kernel path. e.g.
```bash
rbench run --suite cont-batcher --region apac --gpu h100 --kernel v13 --override "batch_window_ms=20,max_batch_tokens=1024" --runs 5
```

nora: also try adding randomized jitter to the scheduler to avoid synchronised coalescing. small patch I used in EU weeks ago reduced p99 spikes. patch snippet:
```python
# scheduler jitter (ms)
window_ms = base_window + random.uniform(-jitter, jitter)
```
works well for mobile bursts.

sylvia: kicked off matt's run (r-2026-03-19-1610). preliminary: p95 -> 140ms, p99 -> 280ms, throughput now -3% vs baseline. So window==20 + max_tokens==1024 largely mitigates the spike. still worse than v12 but acceptable.

ci-bot: automated-run r-2026-03-19-1610 complete. artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/perf/r-2026-03-19-1610/ (profiles, flamegraphs, kernel-choices.csv)

ben: nice. next steps: 1) reproduce in eu/apac infra to confirm region-specificity, 2) add a temporary scheduler rule: priority to fast-kernel path for short requests in APAC, 3) create a regression alert on p95/p99 increase >2x over baseline for cont-batcher.

kenji: will open a small experiment branch to gate kernel v13 by seq-len threshold + region. I'll prototype the dynamic kernel selector.

nora: i'll put the jitter patch behind a flag and run AB in APAC next 24h.

sylvia: action items noted. I'll keep this thread updated with the AB results and dashboard links. For now rolling forward with window=20,max_tokens=1024 in canary APAC pool. :thumbsup:

ben: thanks team — please add short writeup to the perf-runbook once confirmed so SRE/product know mitigation knobs.

sylvia: will do, adding to runbook and tagging eng-sre.
